title: Dashboard Spec
description: Schema for dashboard-composition specifications. A dashboard_spec is the recipe: which cards (by card_id + version range) compose into an evidence package, what synthesis prompts run, what surfaces are rendered. See plan § Target Dashboard Architecture (A3) and § compose-dashboard behavioral spec (B1) for runtime semantics. Cards themselves are validated by card.schema.json.

dashboard_id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier for this dashboard template across versions.

version.description: Semantic version of this dashboard spec. Bumps with card-selection or synthesis-prompt changes.

applies_to.description: Modality and scope axes this dashboard is appropriate for. Compose-dashboard refuses to invoke this dashboard against a (target, indication) whose modality is not in this list, or against an evaluate-target scope not in this list.

modalities.description: Modality axes this dashboard supports. Iter-1b enum expanded to include all active modalities; iter-2 lifts to a $ref against modality.enum.yaml.

scopes.description: evaluate-target scope axes this dashboard supports.

required_context.description: The context-binding shape compose-dashboard must supply at invocation. Mirrors the inputs declared in B1 § compose-dashboard behavioral spec.

target.description: Description of the target binding (typically 'HGNC symbol resolved to canonical Target object via methods/target_id_resolver').

indication.description: Description of the indication binding (typically 'OncoTree code').

subgroup_spec.description: Description of optional subgroup binding (typically 'list of subgroup_ids | "all" | null').

data_mode.description: Reference to data_mode.enum.yaml — the value supplied at invocation must be one of {latest_approved, pinned, exploratory}.

release_pin.description: Catalog manifest_id binding for pinned mode (or null for latest_approved).

modality.description: Iter-1b: optional modality binding. If specified at invocation, must match an entry in `optional_modality_modules`. If unspecified, framework enumerates plausible modalities via modality_axis_compatibility.yaml and applies all matching modules for agnostic enumeration.

required_cards.description: Cards that MUST be in scope for this dashboard. Resolution: each entry's card_id + version range resolves to a specific card_spec in target-contracts/cards/. If a required card's applies_when predicate fails at runtime, the card is excluded with structured exclusion_reason — the dashboard still emits.

optional_cards.description: Cards that may be in scope, gated by a top-level `when:` predicate evaluated against the dashboard's context object before the card's own applies_when is consulted. If `when:` is false, the card is excluded without even invoking applies_when. Predicates use the same CEL-compatible DSL as card-level applies_when (B1 § compose-dashboard subsection 2).

when.description: OPTIONAL CEL-compatible predicate evaluated against the dashboard context. Card-level applies_when runs only if this returns true. When OMITTED, the optional card is admitted unconditionally (compose-dashboard's _evaluate_dashboard_when returns True for a missing/null predicate) — several shipped specs rely on this (e.g. surface-intrinsic-base admits adc-tce-modality-fit, surfaceome-family-classification, shed-ectodomain-liability with no `when`). T2 fix (2026-08-11): `when` was erroneously marked `required`, which made surface-intrinsic-base fail its own schema; the code always treated it as optional.

placeholder_cards.description: Declared-but-not-yet-wired cards (each carries card.status placeholder_not_wired or dormant_pending_data), surfaced here for roadmap transparency but NOT expected to produce output — compose-dashboard emits availability_state=not_wired / excluded_by_applies_when for them and validation does NOT count them as required. Distinct from required_cards (MUST produce) and optional_cards (produce when their `when` gate passes). This is the honest home for a forward-declared capability whose method/product has not landed; moving such a card OUT of required_cards keeps `required` meaning 'must produce'. validate_cards.py enforces: required_cards may only reference status=wired cards.

optional_modality_modules.description: Iter-1b extension: per-modality module references that may load on top of this base dashboard. Resolved at compose-dashboard runtime: if context.modality is specified, load only the matching module; if unspecified, load ALL listed modules for agnostic enumeration. Keys must match `value` entries in modality.enum.yaml; values are paths to modality_module YAMLs validating against modality_module.schema.json.

synthesis_prompts.description: Prompts that drive the dashboard's synthesis layer. Each prompt names a section (headline | caveats_summary | recommendation | etc.) and an instruction string the synthesis engine consumes. Iter-1 synthesis is either rule-based or LLM-driven; the instruction is the contract regardless of engine.

section.description: Section identifier the prompt populates in the evidence_package's synthesis block.

instruction.description: Free-text instruction to the synthesis engine. May reference cards by card_id and may contain {target}, {indication} interpolations.

evidence_package.description: Filename template for the emitted evidence_package.json. May contain {target}, {indication}, {release_pin}, {data_mode} interpolations.

renderings.description: Which rendering surfaces to produce in this run. Iter-1 ships markdown only (Stage 1, A3 maturity ladder); html is iter-2; ppt/decision-memo are iter-3+.

destination.description: Path template (typically data-products/{target}/{indication}/{package_id}/) where compose-dashboard writes outputs.

refresh_policy.description: When compose-dashboard should re-emit. Iter-1 ships on_demand only; nightly/weekly/release-pin-pinned cadences land in iter-2.

schema_version.description: Version of dashboard_spec.schema.json this spec validates against.

card_id.description: Stable identifier matching a card_id in target-contracts/cards/.

version.description: Semver version range constraint (e.g., '>=1.0.0,<2' or '1.0.0' for an exact pin). Structural shape only; the compose-dashboard runtime parses the range with a semver library.
